channel.title: Most Shocking
channel.desc: A collection of real-life videos covering some of the "Most Shocking" police chases, dangerous encounters and acts of criminal behavior. Shot from all perspectives, these videos are tense, thrilling and unbelievable. From bar fights that get out of hand to hostage standoffs with police to high-speed car chases, the action and danger of people out of control is caught on tape.
